hero.subtitle: Ixiera reads your best performing posts (time, hook, length, topic), then helps you plan content and reply to comments in your own voice.
hero.trust1: 7-day trial · 20 free credits · No upfront payment
hero.trust2: Official Meta login, no password stored

problem.title: Being your own account admin is exhausting.
problem.c1_desc: Out of ideas but need to stay consistent.
problem.c2_desc: Replying late, losing interaction and momentum.
problem.c3_desc: Which post, what time, what hook, it's all just a feeling.

features.title: Not just a scheduler.
features.subtitle: Five menus, one flow: plan, post, reply, learn.
features.f1_title: Turn one topic into a 3-day plan.
features.f1_desc: Write a topic and choose a style, Ixiera composes a post plan. Check the free Quick Score before scheduling, and turn your high-performing old posts into Listicles, Opinions, or Stories.
features.f2_desc: Every comment is categorized: question, praise, neutral, spam, toxic. Set each category: answered by AI or using a template. Choose Review Manual or Full Auto, with a reply limit per hour.
features.f3_title: Know what works, not just a feeling.
features.f3_desc: Time with the highest engagement, hook types, post length, and topics, all calculated from your own account data.

pricing.title: Transparent pricing,
pricing.subtitle: no hidden traps. Start with a 7-day trial. If it fits, continue with a monthly plan. This beta price is locked as long as you stay subscribed.
pricing.p1_desc: Try all features with no upfront payment.
pricing.p3_desc: Use your own Gemini/Groq API key.
pricing.p3_f2: API costs go directly to provider
pricing.note1: 1 credit = 1 AI action (generate, AI reply, repurpose, advanced analytics). Template replies and Quick Score are free.
pricing.note2: Beta pricing, locked as long as you stay subscribed.
pricing.faq1_a: No. The price shown is the final price. There are no setup fees, hidden fees, or silent auto-renews.
pricing.faq2_a: So you have full control. We don't want your money to be deducted automatically when you're inactive. You can renew manually anytime.
pricing.faq3_q: What if I run out of credits mid-month?
pricing.faq3_a: You can upgrade to the BYOK plan, or top-up additional credits (coming soon). Template and Quick Score features remain free without credits.
pricing.faq4_a: Prices may increase for new users later. But for you who subscribe now, this beta price is locked forever as long as your subscription is active.
